request.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE opaque landscape 3:2 mailed postcard from a cute pixel firefly companion to its user. Show the whole rectangular cream paper card with clean paper border. Left half contains a little hand-drawn pixel picture of a narrow creek bending around a rounded stone, a tiny twig passing the water gap; it is the pet's fictional creek stone bridge. Right half contains Chinese message in clearly readable dark hand-lettering exactly: 「这次，我到弯的另一边看了看。」 Under it the addressee exactly 「给你」. Upper right a perforated postage stamp with the same adult mint-green fantasy firefly as reference image 1, use the reference only to preserve identity: round joined head/abdomen, black eyes, two short antennae, six short feet, complete broad mint leaf wings, warm gold abdomen tip. A circular ink postal cancellation overlaps the stamp and includes exact Chinese place name 「溪石桥」 and date 「10.26」 with cancellation lines. A thin vertical postal divider separates picture and writing. No English lettering. Cute simplified crisp cartoon pixel illustration, few distinct color blocks; actual Chinese legible on paper. Message, postage stamp, place-name cancellation and postcard proportions must all appear. Card shown alone flat front-on, no hands, no envelope, no mockup desk. Keep postcard opaque.
